name: SkyBlue Pool Supply & Service
addr: 805 University Ave Ste B, Los Gatos, CA 95030
audience: Los Gatos, Campbell and Saratoga pool owners; contractors and spa trade
description: Combined pool service company and retail supply store: weekly maintenance, chemical balancing, equipment repair, and a downtown counter for parts, testing and water analysis.
insight: ZoomInfo lists revenue under $5M with a WordPress and Google Workspace stack: real, but not big enough for a $25K rebuild without a strong ROI story.
usps: Real water testing at a counter, not an app
Service and supply under one roof
differentiators: Publishes water-test results and chemical logic, plus booking for route service

reputation.note: Sixty years of goodwill with duplicated carousel quotes on their own page.

afford: Sixty-plus years of trading, a lease and a retail operation
Service-route revenue is recurring and highly defensible
Existing willingness to pay for web work (2025 rebuild)
risk: Budget ceiling: scope a focused commerce or booking add-on, not a full brand programme
Retail inventory systems may not integrate cleanly

art.logo: Existing signage has a retro script - restore as a 1960s wordmark
art.photoNote: Counter, test kit, tiles, afternoon light on water

copy.h1: Sixty years of reading water on this block.
copy.sub: Weekly pool service, water analysis and a real parts counter - all still run by the same family on University Avenue.
copy.lede: SkyBlue has been the pool counter downtown since 1965. The new website is friendly but empty: no schedule, no inventory, and the same review twice.

concept.dir: Retro pool-supply merchandising: 1960s sign lettering, waterline tile grid, a service-plan picker, and a water-test explainer with a simple chemical chart. Commerce-light but product-aware.
interactive: Service plan picker with pool size inputs
Water chemistry explainer chart (interactive slider for pH/chlorine)
Historic timeline of the shop since 1965
concept.refs: A heritage local shop with a real counter.

web.note: Audited live: a modern 2025 WordPress rebuild, but with a duplicated testimonial carousel, no product inventory, no online ordering and no scheduling - a brochure pretending to be a service business that also sells goods in a store.
